blocks.text: VALENCIA CITY, Bukidnon — A grieving family from Valencia City is pleading for justice after three family members died in a violent road crash along the coastal road in Barangay Puntod, Cagayan de Oro City, on Sunday evening. Witnesses reported that the driver and three occupants of the other vehicle immediately fled on foot after the accident. The victims were identified as brothers Marlon and Marjohn Baspin, and their unnamed 72-year-old mother.
